classification.SOURCE_DERIVED: Methods, definitions, preservation boundaries, algorithms, complexity claims, and failure conditions traceable to the listed source locations.
classification.STRUCTURAL_SYNTHESIS: Cross-chapter routing/recovery structure assembled from source-derived pieces; no new verification theorem is asserted.
classification.IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION: Skill architecture, progressive disclosure, evaluation format, and copyright-safe reconstruction choices.

C10.capability: Choose LTL vs CTL vs CTL*

C17.capability: Model a real-time system with timed automata

C23.capability: Analyze MDP reachability and optimal schedulers

structural_synthesis.ROUTE-01: Unified routing from model kind + property semantics + resource constraints to chapter/method. This combines the book’s chapter-local methods without adding a new verification theorem.
structural_synthesis.RECOVERY-01: Single failure-recovery ladder (model/property/design/capacity) composed from Ch1 result analysis plus Ch6–10 reduction methods.
structural_synthesis.SELF_CHECK-01: Pre/post method checks assembled from explicit assumptions and failure modes across chapters.

implementation_decision.ARCH-01: Keep SKILL.md as controller/router and load chapter files on demand to satisfy book-to-skill progressive-disclosure guidance.
implementation_decision.EVAL-01: Use solution-manual exercises as secondary evaluation prompts because the booklet is explicitly a selected-solution draft; do not treat it as stronger authority than the main book.
implementation_decision.COPYRIGHT-01: Reconstruct examples and algorithms compactly; avoid long verbatim passages or raw book code.

chapter_coverage.title: System Verification
chapter_coverage.core: Operational verification loop: model + formal property -> check -> interpret result -> refine/reverify; distinguish verification from validation; manage state explosion and experiment provenance.

chapter_coverage.title: Modelling Concurrent Systems
chapter_coverage.core: Transition systems, program graphs, interleaving, shared variables, handshaking, FIFO channels, nanoPromela, synchronous product, atomicity, state-space explosion.

chapter_coverage.title: Linear-Time Properties
chapter_coverage.core: Deadlock, paths/traces, trace equivalence, invariants, safety/bad prefixes, liveness, safety-liveness decomposition, fairness constraints and realizability.

chapter_coverage.title: Regular Properties
chapter_coverage.core: Finite-word and Büchi automata, regular safety, omega-regular properties, product constructions, persistence checking, nested DFS.

chapter_coverage.title: Linear Temporal Logic
chapter_coverage.core: LTL syntax/semantics, specification patterns, equivalences/normal forms, fairness encoding, LTL-to-GNBA/NBA construction, automata-based checking, complexity.

chapter_coverage.title: Computation Tree Logic
chapter_coverage.core: CTL/CTL* branching-time semantics, bottom-up model checking, fixed points, fairness, witnesses/counterexamples, symbolic ROBDD checking, expressiveness vs LTL.

chapter_coverage.title: Equivalences and Abstraction
chapter_coverage.core: Bisimulation, simulation, trace/stutter relations, quotienting/refinement algorithms, logical preservation boundaries, divergence sensitivity.

chapter_coverage.title: Partial Order Reduction
chapter_coverage.core: Action independence, ample-set reduction for LTL\X and branching time, dynamic/static POR, cycle provisos, sticky actions.

chapter_coverage.title: Timed Automata
chapter_coverage.core: Clocked models, time divergence/timelock/zenoness, TCTL, clock regions, finite region transition systems, PSPACE-complete TCTL checking.

chapter_coverage.title: Probabilistic Systems
chapter_coverage.core: Markov chains, PCTL/PCTL*, probabilistic bisimulation, costs/rewards, MDP schedulers, reachability/value iteration/LP, end components, omega-regular objectives, fairness.

chapter_coverage.title: Appendix: Preliminaries
chapter_coverage.core: Symbols, formal languages, propositional logic, graphs, computational complexity.

notes: Bibliographic notes and the complete bibliography/index were processed for scope/terminology but are not reproduced as runtime reference lists.
Exercise material is used for worked checks and eval design rather than copied wholesale.
Long source passages and raw source code are intentionally omitted; examples are compact reconstructions.
